The runner also checks every step and the end table. A zero-step LatticeResult must leave the state unplayed with identity
labels. An invalid result or failed check ends error. An operator signal ends the run error and keeps the phase result null,
Both children run with no clock in the chapter's configuration. Clock exits are part of the interface, but are not observed
Committed research evidence · provisional colours · no Windows/DirectX or performance claim
